issues.title: Spatial Archive Redesign
issues.description: Transition from a vertical scroll-based layout to a spatial, multi-window 'Desktop' or 'Archive Canvas' inspired by The HTML Review. Implement draggable components and non-linear discovery.

issues.title: Refine Experimental Visuals & Interactions
issues.description: Enhance the 'Spatial Archive' by adding more web-native art elements like reactive cursors, granular glitches, and non-linear content structure within fragments, inspired by Issue 05 of The HTML Review.
